entries.finding: R8 resultRow exact-checked row cardinality but only checked presence of the requested row key. It accepted unknown sibling transport keys in both proven wrappers and accepted an unproven bare keyed-object fallback.
entries.repair: Accept only the two independently evidenced transport containers: a one-row array or the exact boundary/rows/warning wrapper. Require exactly one plain-object row whose sole key is the requested receipt key. Remove the bare-object fallback.
entries.acceptance: Nineteen R9 transport tests cover exact accepted forms, cardinality, type, unknown and missing keys, legacy aliases, wrapper binding, snapshot exactness, contradictions, bare-object rejection, and proof that invalid transport cannot reach classification.

preservedR8AndR7.replay: The R9 validator preserves all 182 accepted R8 checks and executes the untouched 172-check source R7 replay from the source R7 packet directory.
